problem_statement: RIOT should provide a mbed TLS package that can be enabled with USEPKG += mbedtls. When the mbedtls_entropy module is used, RIOT must expose a convenience entropy API: int entropy_mbedtls_riot_init(void), int entropy_mbedtls_riot_retrieve(unsigned char *output, len), void entropy_mbedtls_riot_uninit(void), and int entropy_mbedtls_riot_get(unsigned char *output, len). These functions must let an application initialize, retrieve, uninitialize, and get entropy from the mbed TLS entropy module (as in entropy_mbedtls_riot_retrieve(out, sizeof(out))). The package must also make mbedtls_sha256_self_test(1) and mbedtls_entropy_self_test(1) run and report success.

verification.reason: The statement gives the package enable syntax (USEPKG += mbedtls), the module name (mbedtls_entropy), all four convenience function signatures, and the requirement that mbedtls_sha256_self_test(1) and mbedtls_entropy_self_test(1) run and report success. The header name entropy_mbedtls_riot.h is strongly implied by the function names (all prefixed entropy_mbedtls_riot_), the self-test output strings are standard mbed TLS outputs a developer would encounter, and the pseudomodules (mbedtls_entropy_source_hwrng/adc) are only referenced in test Makefile comments/conditionals that are not active for the default test configuration.
